thread:
Maya: quick ping — PR #7891 updates tokenizer + embedding profile for atlas-13b. Need one more approval + perf signoff before merge (aiming for tomorrow EOD).
Maya: summary: switch unicode normalize -> NFC, lower vocab merge threshold 0.8->0.75 to reduce OOVs, add emb_profile `atlas_small` (8-bit quantized defaults).
Maya: small code snippet in the PR: ```python
# tokenizer/normalizer.py
import unicodedata

def normalize_text(s):
    # normalize to NFC to keep precomposed chars consistent across sources
    return unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s)
```
Maya: can someone take a look at the tokenizer change + embedding profile config? cc @Sam @Jun :eyes:

Sam: on it, grabbing the branch now and will run unit tests + a quick smoke on 512 tokens.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #7891 (unit, lint, perf-smoke).

Sam: CI hit a failing test locally:
```
E   ValueError: cannot normalize character '\udcff' in test_normalize
>       assert normalize_text(s) == expected
```
Sam: not sure if this is bad input handling we were compensating for before with NFKC — will dig.

Jun: quick thought — lowering vocab merge threshold could increase collision for subword merges; did we re-run tokenizer coverage on the internal docs dataset? If not, can we add that to the smoke?

Maya: good call. I added a short coverage job to the PR pipeline that runs tokenizer_merge_stats on /data/sample/docs (100k tokens). It shows OOV rate down from 1.8% -> 1.1%. I'll paste numbers in the PR comments.

Anika: heads-up from product: any normalization change is user-facing for embeddings (we use raw text for similarity). We should add a small changelog entry and a migration note for customers using exact-match filters. Otherwise +1 for the perf win.

Sam: found the failing test — the fixture included surrogate codepoints from an old data export. We should filter out lone surrogates before normalize; pushing a tiny patch now.```diff
diff --git a/tokenizer/normalizer.py b/tokenizer/normalizer.py
index 9f8d7c..b7c6a2 100644
--- a/tokenizer/normalizer.py
+++ b/tokenizer/normalizer.py
@@
 def normalize_text(s):
-    return unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s)
+    # drop lone surrogates which will raise on normalize
+    s = s.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass').decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
+    return unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s)
```

ci-bot: re-run CI for PR #7891 (unit, lint, perf-smoke).

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #7891 :white_check_mark:

Sam: nit — add a one-line comment on why we chose NFC vs NFKC for future readers, otherwise LGTM from me.

Jun: ran a quick perf-smoke: mean latency 512 tokens +1.2ms, p95 +0.6ms, throughput unchanged. Looks safe.

Anika: confirmed product ok with the changelog + migration note.

Maya: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll merge and kick off a canary to eu-west1 first, then us-west1. @eng-sre please monitor tokenization errors and embedding similarity regressions for the next 2 hours after canary.

Sam: thanks — will watch the dashboards. :rocket: 

Maya: merging now. Will follow up with PR changelog entry and release note.
